verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs repeatedly reference its own SDKs. A Messaging SDK exposes createEmail, createSms and createPush, functions can be triggered by SDK methods, and the CLI `generate` command builds a type-safe SDK typed to the project's database schema. For AI-native use, open-source Skills files and the MCP server give agents current knowledge of the SDKs so they make SDK-accurate calls. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of official SDK languages/platforms with install docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
